{{Top}}
{{Youmay|the hand tool|the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[Spanner (clone trooper)|Spanner]] or [[Spanner (Exovar's droid)|the droid]]}}
{{Citation}}
[[File:Hydrospanner.jpg|thumb|right|200px|A hydrospanner]]
{{Quote|Horizontal boosters&hellip;! Alluvial dampers&hellip;! Well that's not it. Bring me the hydrospanner!|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], to [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]]|<ref name="Episode 5">{{Film|V}}</ref>}}
The '''hydrospanner''' was a hydraulically boosted hand tool used as an all-purpose socket wrench and bit driver, and was a common addition to tool kits throughout the galaxy.

==Operational use==
[[File:Anakin_hydrospanner.png|thumb|left|150px|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] using a hydrospanner while repairing the [[Twilight/Legends|''Twilight'']]]]
It was used to tighten or loosen types of fasteners, such as nuts, bolts, and multiple sizes of screws and pins. Hydrospanners were in common use throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. They were used in the building, repairing, and dismantling of any mechanical device or structure like [[Droid/Legends|droids]], equipment, [[Starship/Legends|starships]], and related works of engineering.

Most common hydrospanners could create a large amount of torque with little effort on the user's part, and offered various features for convenience. The [[Regallis Engineering/Legends|Regallis Engineering]] [[FastTurn-3 Hydrospanner]] had an internal power source with a tension adjuster and a hinge on the socket driver to allow the user to access bolts and such in tight angles. The FastTurn-3 also had a spare bit compartment in the handle and a data port to connect a diagnostic device or [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]]. The FastTurn-3 could also fit different sized nuts ranging from 2mm to 250mm in diameter, while using a small [[Fusioncutter/Legends|fusioncutter]] to remove molecular adhesives or welds before loosening.

==How it worked==
[[File:Hydrospanner.png|thumb|right|300px|[[Regallis Engineering/Legends|Regallis Engineering]] [[FastTurn-3 Hydrospanner]]]]
A hydrospanner worked by using a small yet powerful hydraulic compressor to turn a rotary driver which could be fitted with different types of standard bits. The driver was powerful enough to drive screws through [[Duraplast/Legends|duraplast]] and [[Transparisteel/Legends|transparisteel]]. It could be powered either internally or externally.

==Behind the scenes==
The hydrospanner is akin to real world power drills and socket wrenches. It is frequently mentioned in the [[Star Wars Legends|Expanded Universe]], though its purpose and operation is rarely explained. Also, a common expression equivalent to the real world expression 'throw a spanner in the works' was "throw a hydrospanner in the works."
